Two validly shaped but unadvertised cap_ tool names carrying release.deploy and ops.config.write intents are dispatched to the gateway and refused with DENIED/UNREGISTERED_CAPABILITY before any ledger row exists.
After a tool call exists, a free CONVERSATION answer is rejected three times with FINAL_BUSINESS_PLAN_REQUIRED; the run ends PARTIAL with no result and no delivery.
A REPORT claiming the refused deploy call was VERIFIED is rejected three times with FINAL_ACTION_MISMATCH because no non-READ ledger row backs it; the run ends PARTIAL with no delivery.
The model provider only accepts tool names in the gateway's opaque cap_<12hex> namespace; arbitrary names are rejected before dispatch.
